sources.title: Password help
sources.content: To reset a forgotten password, open the IT help portal and choose the password reset option. Reset links expire after 30 minutes.

sources.title: WiFi and VPN
sources.content: Campus WiFi uses your staff or student ID. VPN access requires the IT portal's remote access request form and manager approval.

sources.title: Software requests
sources.content: Licensed software is installed through the IT self-service portal. Requests are reviewed within two working days.

sources.title: Leave policy
sources.content: Annual leave requests must be approved by the reporting manager before the planned leave date. Sick leave requires a certificate after three consecutive days.

sources.title: Payroll
sources.content: Salary is credited on the last working day of each month. Payslips are available in the HR self-service portal.

sources.title: Attendance
sources.content: Attendance corrections must be submitted to HR within five working days of the missed punch.

sources.title: Fee payments
sources.content: Students can download an itemized invoice and payment receipt from the fees portal after each transaction.

sources.title: Deadlines
sources.content: Semester fees must be paid by the date on the academic calendar. Late payments attract a fine listed in the fee circular.

sources.title: Scholarships and refunds
sources.content: Scholarship adjustments appear on the next invoice. Refund requests are processed through the fees portal within ten working days.

sources.title: Maintenance requests
sources.content: A room maintenance request should include the room number, issue description and urgency level. Emergency issues go to the facilities hotline.

sources.title: Room bookings
sources.content: Meeting rooms and halls are booked through the facilities portal at least two days in advance.

sources.title: Gym and recreation
sources.content: The campus gym is open 6am to 9pm on working days. A valid ID card is required for entry.

sources.title: Campus contacts
sources.content: The main help desk is in the admin block, open 9am to 5pm. Department contacts are listed in the staff directory.

sources.title: Academic calendar
sources.content: Term dates, examination windows and holidays are published in the academic calendar on the portal.
